economic_hypothesis: A causal long-horizon bull cycle can contain a short-horizon market correction. During that correction, a stock already down at least 10% over twenty sessions that makes a new five-session low but closes above the prior high in the upper 30% of its range on normal-or-higher turnover shows completed-session supply absorption and may rebound rapidly.
entry: first legal next daily open within three market sessions

event.cooldown: retain first event per symbol in each causal 10-session window
event.full_absorption: close>=prior-session high; close location>=70%; turnover>=prior20 mean

exit: target or causal H5/H10/H15 decision then next legal open

market_state.BEAR_CYCLE: market median ret60<=0 and positive-ret60 share<=50%
market_state.BULL_CYCLE: market median ret60>0 and positive-ret60 share>50%

rules.R4_GAP_SHOCK_ABSORBED: R1 and signal open<=99% of prior close
